title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5720 South 142nd Street in Omaha, Nebraska, as the "Petty Officer 1st Class Caleb A. Nelson Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5720 South 142nd Street in Omaha, Nebraska, as the "Petty Officer 1st Class Caleb A. Nelson Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A 2016 law renames a Omaha, Nebraska Postal Service building after Navy Petty Officer Caleb A. Nelson.
summary.what_it_does: The law names a specific U.S. Postal Service facility at 5720 South 142nd Street in Omaha, Nebraska, the Petty Officer 1st Class Caleb A. Nelson Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office runs, what services it offers, or what postal rules apply.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016.
